players.product: AI-enabled antibody and drug discovery programs

quarterly_data.signal: Regulatory progress outside the U.S. obesity franchise. Dan Skovronsky said the CHMP adopted a positive opinion recommending EU approval of insulin efsitora alfa for Type 2 diabetes (Dave Ricks gave the trade name Onswik), based on the phase III program in which once-weekly efsitora achieved A1C reductions comparable to once-daily basal insulin, and that Lilly looks forward to European approval in the coming months. Dave Ricks said Lilly completed the U.S. submission of Foundayo for Type 2 diabetes and expects regulatory action later this year. Dan Skovronsky said Lilly plans to submit lebrikizumab's pediatric atopic dermatitis indication to other global regulators later this year.
quarterly_data.figure: CHMP positive opinion for insulin efsitora alfa (Onswik); EU approval expected in the coming months; Foundayo Type 2 diabetes U.S. regulatory action expected later this year

quarterly_data.signal: Dan Skovronsky gave the clinical status of the newly acquired pipeline. AtaiBeckley's lead asset BPL-003, a rapid-acting neuroplastogen for treatment-resistant depression, has shown encouraging phase II-B results. Cleminorexton, from Centessa, is a potential best-in-class orexin receptor 2 agonist in a phase II/III trial in central hypersomnias. Curevo's amezosvatein, a potential next-generation varicella-zoster virus vaccine for shingles prevention, showed a comparable immune response with meaningfully improved tolerability in a phase II head-to-head study against the current standard of care. LimmaTech's most advanced program is in phase I for prevention of the leading bacterial cause of surgical site infections, and The Vaccine Company's lead program targets Epstein-Barr virus, an infection with no vaccine today.
quarterly_data.figure: BPL-003 encouraging phase II-B results; cleminorexton phase II/III; amezosvatein phase II head-to-head comparable immune response with improved tolerability; LimmaTech program in phase I
